title: Why Google Gemini 2.5 changes everything for developers

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Google Gemini 2.5 is a marketing stunt, not a real breakthrough for developers. It doesn’t fix the core issues in AI integration.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Wrong. Gemini 2.5 supports real-time multilingual coding and integrates with Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, giving developers unmatched scalability and speed.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: That’s hype. Real developers need open protocols, not proprietary tools. Gemini 2.5 doesn’t support standard ML frameworks like ONNX or PyTorch natively.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: It does support PyTorch and TensorFlow through its unified API, reducing deployment time by 40% and cutting infrastructure costs significantly.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Gemini 2.5 is the future—developers need power, not just open source for the sake of it.
